rationale: C06 is a clear, material drafting precursor. It addresses the identical problem of chronic labor-surplus areas, describes coordinated action by multiple federal agencies, emphasizes intensified executive assistance, and closes by discussing proposed legislation to provide additional federal authority. The child compresses and updates this same administrative-and-legislative framework after a further agency review. C15 shares the policy subject and the combination of administrative aid with requested legislation, but its veto-message structure is substantially different. C16 only weakly parallels the transmission of a relevant report.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I called together the appropriate officials in those federal agencies having programs affecting chronic labor surplus areas, to again review pertinent activities within their province.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: fourteen agencies of the Executive Branch have been contributing either direct or indirect assistance in such areas... Last year I directed an intensification of these Federal efforts
shared_material.explanation: Both frame the response as a presidentially directed, multi-agency review and intensification of federal assistance to the same class of areas.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As a result of this meeting a number of additional executive actions have been taken to further assist these areas.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Through more intensified efforts of the Federal coordinating committee above described... I anticipate that additional industrial activity can be stimulated and more job opportunities made available.
shared_material.explanation: The child updates the earlier coordinating machinery by reporting additional executive actions resulting from another review.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the revised legislation which has been submitted on behalf of the Administration represents a sound and forthright program for assisting the states and localities in dealing with the problems of chronic unemployment.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have repeatedly urged that the Congress pass legislation which I have specifically proposed to assist areas of urgent need. This legislation would give the government additional authority and finances to help these areas
shared_material.explanation: Both pair ongoing administrative measures with Administration-sponsored legislation intended to expand assistance for persistent unemployment.

shared_material.child_excerpt: we will continue to take every possible administrative action we can to assist chronic labor surplus areas
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Our policy is twofold: Efficient coordination among Federal agencies and full cooperation by these Federal agencies with state and local governments... that seek to help areas with substantial and persistent unemployment.
shared_material.explanation: The child's concluding commitment condenses the earlier letter's stated policy of coordinated federal administrative assistance.
